bead.title: Quarantine inline YAML UMF as migration-only
bead.description:
Remove inline whole-UMF YAML from the normal public authoring/loading path. Product/spec language treats split YAML directories as the editable format and JSON as the artifact/interchange format, but src/tablespec/umf_loader.py still exposes UMFFormat.INLINE and detect_format() auto-detects any .yaml/.yml/.umf file as a whole-UMF document. CLI examples and fixtures using *.umf.yaml make agents default to an inline YAML format that should not be canonical. Preserve any needed compatibility as an explicit migration path only, not autodetected normal loading.

Current evidence:
- src/tablespec/umf_loader.py defines UMFFormat.INLINE and _load_inline_yaml().
- detect_format() returns INLINE for .yaml/.yml/.umf files.
- CLI examples mention table.umf.yaml for validate/generate/emit/export/explore.
- specs name split and JSON as the supported formats for normal workflows.

In-scope files:
- src/tablespec/umf_loader.py
- src/tablespec/cli.py user-facing examples/errors and any explicit migration command if kept
- docs/helix format requirements and user stories that still imply inline YAML
- tests for loader/CLI format detection

Out-of-scope for this bead:
- Rewriting every conformance fixture unless required by tests
- Changing compiled artifact snapshot format without a separate decision
- Bootstrap facade work
bead.acceptance:
1. UMFLoader.load() no longer auto-loads arbitrary single-file YAML UMF documents through the normal path; split directories and JSON continue to load.
2. If inline YAML compatibility remains, it is reachable only through an explicit migration API/CLI path whose name includes migration or legacy.
3. CLI help/examples no longer present table.umf.yaml as the canonical authoring input for validate/generate/emit/export/explore.
4. A test command such as uv run pytest tests/unit/test_umf_loader.py tests/unit/test_cli.py -k "format or inline or convert" passes and includes a regression that single-file YAML is rejected or migration-only.
5. Specs/docs consistently state: split YAML directory for editing, JSON for artifact/interchange, inline YAML is not a supported canonical format.
